cues.zhText: 在病理学家眼里，急性阑尾炎的本质，始终绕不开两个核心动作——“变质”和“渗出”。
cues.enText: In pathology, acute appendicitis centers on two processes: tissue injury and exudation.

cues.zhText: 如果阑尾腔堵塞，腔内压会升高。缺血和细菌可使黏膜坏死、脱落并形成溃疡，这种组织损伤叫作“变质”。
cues.enText: An obstruction can raise pressure inside the appendix. Ischemia and bacteria can cause mucosal necrosis, sloughing and ulceration. This is tissue injury.

cues.zhText: 炎症使血管扩张、通透性增加，液体和蛋白外渗。分叶核中性粒细胞变形，穿过内皮间隙，化脓时可浸润全层。这些都属于“渗出”。
cues.enText: Inflamed vessels dilate and become more permeable, allowing fluid and proteins to leak out. Neutrophils with lobed nuclei deform and cross endothelial gaps. In suppurative disease they can infiltrate the full wall. All of this is exudation.

cues.zhText: 化脓时，中性粒细胞可穿过肌层、浸润阑尾壁全层。最外面的浆膜可覆有纤维素性脓性渗出物。
cues.enText: In suppurative appendicitis, neutrophils can infiltrate the full wall, including muscle. The outer serosa may be coated with fibrinous-purulent exudate.

cues.zhText: 交织的纤维素丝网中，可见大量变性、坏死的中性粒细胞，也就是脓细胞。这层纤维素性脓性渗出物，使阑尾表面呈灰黄色。
highlightZh: 变性、坏死的中性粒细胞
cues.enText: The fibrin mesh contains many degenerated and necrotic neutrophils, or pus cells. This fibrinous-purulent exudate gives the appendix its grayish-yellow surface.
